AgentRef.description: Which agent instance and conversation the event belongs to.

run_id.description: One agent turn/run inside the session, if known
run_id.title: Run Id

parent_session_id.description: Session that delegated to this one (sub-agent spawn), if any
parent_session_id.title: Parent Session Id

AgentRef.title: AgentRef

AgentType.description: The AI agent product that produced the activity.
AgentType.title: AgentType

ApprovalResolution.description:
An answer to a pre-execution approval prompt (``require_approval`` or ``security_approval``).

Links back to the ``tool.call`` event and findings that asked for it, so security can audit
what users approved after the fact. ``approver`` is who pressed the button when the agent
reports it; OpenClaw plugin approvals do not, so it is usually ``None`` (see the requester labels).

request_event_id.description: The tool.call event that was held
request_event_id.title: Request Event Id

judged_by.description: Which path asked: daemon, cached-policy CLI, or risk-tier fallback
judged_by.title: Judged By

via.description: Who was asked: the person in the agent UI (require_approval), or security in the console (security_approval, M11; approver = who decided there)
via.title: Via

ApprovalResolution.title: ApprovalResolution

withheld.description: Text left on the endpoint: no rule hit, so only its length is sent (data minimization)
withheld.title: Withheld

ComponentIntegrity.description: One installed unit of agent code compared with what its publisher signed.

package.description: npm package expected to contain it, e.g. "openclaw"
package.title: Package

origin.description: openclaw: core | bundled | global | config | workspace
origin.title: Origin

integrity.description: verified: matches a signed package; mismatch: differs from it (tampered); pending: no verified digests for this version yet; unknown: no package or pin vouches for it
integrity.title: Integrity

trust.description: Status of the package version it belongs to (policy manifests)
trust.title: Trust

ComponentIntegrity.title: ComponentIntegrity

ConfigSnapshot.description:
Security-relevant settings of an agent installation, read from its own config.

Only allowlisted fields are copied: the config file also holds tokens and account details,
which never leave the endpoint. Emitted at sensor start and whenever these fields change.

path.description: Config file the values came from
path.title: Path

changed.description: Fields that differ from the previous snapshot
changed.title: Changed

guard_plugin.description: The SG-Advance enforcement plugin as the config leaves it
guard_plugin.title: Guard Plugin

ConfigSnapshot.title: ConfigSnapshot

Endpoint.description: The machine (container / VM / PC) the agent runs on.
Endpoint.title: Endpoint

ExecPolicy.description: Shell-execution policy at one scope. ``None`` means "not set here" (the agent's default).

mode.description: openclaw: deny | allowlist | ask | auto | full
mode.title: Mode

ExecPolicy.title: ExecPolicy

InstallSnapshot.description:
One agent installation found on the endpoint, managed or not (shadow AI discovery).

Sent per install when it is first seen, when its state changes, and once more with
``present=false`` when it disappears. Only the product's own traces are read (its binary,
state directory, service file, its gateway port on 127.0.0.1); nothing else on the machine.

instance.description: What identifies this install: its state dir, or the code path if never set up
instance.title: Instance

present.description: false: the install was seen before and is gone now
present.title: Present

changed.description: Fields that differ from the previous snapshot
changed.title: Changed

install_path.description: Package directory of the code that runs it
install_path.title: Install Path

install_source.description: npm-global | nvm | pnpm | volta | app | other (from the path)
install_source.title: Install Source

configured.description: A config file exists (the install was set up)
configured.title: Configured

services.description: launchd / systemd units that start it
services.title: Services

guard_plugin.description: The SG-Advance plugin as the install's config leaves it
guard_plugin.title: Guard Plugin

watched.description: This sensor watches the install's config and gateway
watched.title: Watched

managed.description: configured, guard plugin enabled and watched
managed.title: Managed

InstallSnapshot.title: InstallSnapshot

IntegrityReport.description: Installed agent code vs. known-good digests from the policy. Sent when anything changes.
IntegrityReport.title: IntegrityReport

InventorySnapshot.description: What one agent can use. Multi-agent gateways send one snapshot per agent (``agent_id``).

model_runtimes.description: Selectable models and the runtime each runs with (gateway view)
model_runtimes.title: Model Runtimes

sessions.description: Live (unarchived) conversations of this agent and their runtime binding
sessions.title: Sessions

InventorySnapshot.title: InventorySnapshot

ModelRuntime.description: The runtime a selectable model would run with on the gateway right now (``models.list``).

source.description: Where the runtime came from: model (pinned) / implicit (OpenClaw chose) / ...
source.title: Source

ModelRuntime.title: ModelRuntime

OperatorAction.description:
A person acting on the gateway's control surface: answering an approval prompt, stopping a
run, archiving or deleting a conversation. Recorded by the audit proxy between the identity
proxy and the gateway, so ``principal`` is the person who acted (from SSO), not the one whose
agent ran. OpenClaw itself only stores the client app as the resolver.

Only control messages are read; conversations pass through untouched.

method.description: Gateway RPC the person's client sent, e.g. plugin.approval.resolve
method.title: Method

ok.description: Gateway accepted it; None if no answer was seen
ok.title: Ok

call_id.description: Tool call the approval was for, when the gateway said
call_id.title: Call Id

target_session_id.description: Session of the approval or the stopped run
target_session_id.title: Target Session Id

archived_only.description: session.delete: only if already archived (what members may do)
archived_only.title: Archived Only

changes.description: session.privilege: "field=value" per permission field set (e.g. permissionMode=full)
changes.title: Changes

OperatorAction.title: OperatorAction

source.description: Install source: registry, path, git url ...
source.title: Source

Principal.description: The human the agent acts on behalf of.
Principal.title: Principal

RuntimePin.description:
Which runtime executes a model's turns. Tools that run inside a foreign runtime (e.g. a CLI
backend) may never pass the gateway's pre-execution hooks.

runtime.description: Pinned runtime id, or "default" when nothing pins it
runtime.title: Runtime

RuntimePin.title: RuntimePin

SandboxPolicy.description:
Where an agent's tools run. ``mode_source: default`` means not configured: the agent's
built-in default applies (OpenClaw: ``off``, i.e. directly on the host).

elevated_default.description: openclaw agents.defaults.elevatedDefault: off | on | ask | full (effective)
elevated_default.title: Elevated Default

SandboxPolicy.title: SandboxPolicy

SensorHealth.description:
State of an enforcement or observation component, reported by the sensor itself.
A component that goes quiet (e.g. a gateway plugin that stopped sending heartbeats) is a
control gap: tool calls may now run without a pre-execution check.

last_seen.description: Last sign of life before this report
last_seen.title: Last Seen

SensorHealth.title: SensorHealth

SensorType.description:
How the activity was observed. One agent can be seen by several sensors
(e.g. Claude Code via its hooks *and* via the MCP proxy).
SensorType.title: SensorType

SessionBinding.description: The runtime one live conversation is bound to, compared with what its model would get now (T19).

expected_runtime.description: Runtime its model resolves to now (models.list); None if not listed
expected_runtime.title: Expected Runtime

binding.description: current: same as its model's pinned runtime; stale: bound to another runtime than the pin (config changed after it started); unpinned: its model has no pin; unknown: model not listed
binding.title: Binding

SessionBinding.title: SessionBinding

permission_mode.description: Agent-native approval mode, e.g. default | plan | acceptEdits | bypassPermissions (Claude Code), yolo (Gemini CLI), full-auto (Codex CLI)
permission_mode.title: Permission Mode

interactive.description: False when started without a human at a terminal (-p, no TTY, CI)
interactive.title: Interactive

parent_process.description: Executable that launched the agent, e.g. zsh, node, python
parent_process.title: Parent Process

SkillDescriptor.description: An agent skill (instructions + scripts the model can load), e.g. OpenClaw ``SKILL.md``.

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. openclaw-bundled / -extra / -managed / -workspace
source.title: Source

eligible.description: Requirements met, so the agent can use it
eligible.title: Eligible

integrity.description: verified: matches a digest security approved; mismatch: an approved skill changed; unknown: nobody approved it. None: not checked (bundled with the agent, or files not readable)
integrity.title: Integrity

trust.description: Status of the approval it matched (approved / revoked)
trust.title: Trust

SkillDescriptor.title: SkillDescriptor

Source.description: The sensor/adapter that emitted the event.
Source.title: Source

ToolCall.description:
Emitted *before* a tool executes. Sensors that can block (hooks, proxies) wait for the
local policy verdict on this event.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

ToolDescriptor.description: A tool as advertised to the model (used for inventory / tool-poisoning checks).
ToolDescriptor.title: ToolDescriptor

mcp_server.description: MCP server name as configured by the client
mcp_server.title: Mcp Server

withheld.description: Text left on the endpoint: no rule hit, so only its length is sent (data minimization)
withheld.title: Withheld

ts.description: When it happened on the endpoint (UTC recommended)
ts.title: Ts
